findings.evidence: Hard-link aliases were accepted by lexical/resolved-path checks. Reject multiply linked documentary inputs before payload reads.
The loader accepted nonregular and unbounded files. Require regular bounded documents and bounded reads.
Boolean economics passed Python numeric operations. Require finite int/float values excluding bool.
Synthetic causal checker accepted arbitrary later fills. Enforce first synthetic minute boundary and document uninterrupted schedule assumption.
Synthetic checker had no flatten boundary. Add completion/fill flatten checks and retained refusal reasons.
Warmup losses were aggregated despite per-session reset records. Add disjoint initial/contract/gap breakdown.
Calibration allocation had no chronological partition in the ledger. Assign hypothetical population roles and report transition dates without admitting calibration.
Calendar dates were bound only to an authored summary. Add original official NYSE HTML snapshot and bind source IDs; preserve proxy-only limitation.
Design report.md inherited generic sample-size table and no horizon link. Direct it to the actual comparison, preserving existing readiness behavior.
Frozen historical candidate modeled-latency metadata conflicted with prospective actual-availability instructions. State explicit prospective precedence.
Guide said market paths refused, but market/market_data components were accepted. Add lexical guards before documentary read.
Same-zone DST folds compare wall times in Python. Normalize to UTC before causal arithmetic/comparisons.
Calendar-aware next-session logic lacked a regression test. Exercise holiday and early-close skipping through run and assert both dates.

followup_review: All three original reviewers confirmed closure; no remaining concrete issues or deferrals.
